name: Krishak Praja Party
contribution: Under A.K. Fazlul Huq, the party articulated agrarian demands and built cross-class support that reconfigured Bengal provincial politics in the 1930s.
context: Late-colonial electoral politics, peasant mobilization, and the 1937 provincial government formation.
impact: It shifted the political center toward rural constituencies and reshaped coalition politics in Bengal before partition.
